stories.title: Long wait ends as lawyer meets jailed Imran, Bushra
stories.brief: After a gap of several months, government authorities on Monday allowed Barrister Salman Safdar to meet his incarcerated clientsformer prime minister and PTI founder Imran Khan and his spouse Bushra Bibi at Rawalpindi's Adiala Jail.

stories.title: PM warns banks over slow loans
stories.brief: The prime minister directed the State Bank of Pakistan (SBP) and the Ministry of Finance on Monday not to extend concessions to banks failing to expedite lending to farmers, small and medium enterprises (SMEs) and consumers under the Apna Ghar housing scheme.

stories.title: PTI lawyer Salman Safdar says he met Imran, Bushra Bibi at Adiala jail
stories.brief: PTI lawyer Barrister Salman Safdar on Monday said he met with party founder Imran Khan and his spouse, Bushra Bibi, at Rawalpindi’s Adiala jail, where they are both incarcerated. When asked about Imran’s health, Akram replied that although health issues were discussed, the PTI would only speak about the legal cases.

stories.title: PM directs no leniency for banks slow in providing loans to farmers, SMEs
stories.brief: Prime Minister Shahbaz Sharif on Monday directed that no leniency should be shown to banks who were slow in providing loans to farmers, small and medium enterprises (SMEs), and consumers under the Prime Minister’s Apna Ghar Scheme.

stories.title: Refineries to shoulder Rs15b fuel burden
stories.brief: Ali Pervaiz Malik announced that oil refineries would bear a burden of approximately Rs15 per litre or Rs15 billion for one month, which would allow petrol to be sold Rs15 cheaper than what it was in the global market amid the US-Israeli war on Iran.

stories.title: Tax evasion: panel seeks recovery of Rs1.12tr
stories.brief: A Senate Sub-Committee on Interior and Anti-Narcotics has expressed serious concern over the alleged misuse of the FATA/PATA tax exemption scheme, delays in recovering billions of rupees in outstanding taxes and the failure of several companies to provide required records.

stories.title: Bilal urges embracing financial innovation
stories.brief: Addressing a dialogue on "Digital Assets and the Future of Banking" at the Lahore University of Management Sciences (LUMS), he said Pakistan needed to play an active role in shaping the rules of the emerging international financial system.
